newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore weekly residues down, distillates mixed.
newsitem.headline: Singapore weekly residues down, distillates mixed.

text.p: Singapore weekly residue stocks fell 1.634 million barrels in the week ending March 5 to 10.595 million barrels, Singapore's Trade Development Board (TDB) said.
They include HSFO, LSFO, LSWR and the straight-run atmospheric residue, but exclude bitumen.
Middle-distillate stocks also fell by 556,000 barrels to 6.712 million barrels.
Middle distillates comprise jet, kerosene and gas oil.
Light distillate stocks rose by 615,000 barrels to 5.634 million barrels. They comprise gasoline, reformate and naphtha.
